scenario: Duplicate `cooldown` modifier on the same rule is a parse-time error per LCDB.7.8 / LGRA.6.6.7. The grammar accepts `rate_mod*` but the compiler folds duplicates and rejects.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r cooldown 5_min cooldown 1_min:
    Trig
->
    log info "x"
